meta_data.base_class: get top brands for a specific product within <retail platform> - these platforms sell multiple product categories and maintain brand-level information.

tool_template.name: find_top_brands_in_<class>
tool_template.description: Get top brands of a specific product within <class>.

product.description: The product for which the top brands should be fetched within <class>.

number.description: Number of top brands to be fetched.

organic.description: If the product should be organic.

region.description: The geographical region where the top brands are to be identified within <class>.

price_range.description: The price range filter for selecting top brands of the specific product within <class>. Format as 'min-max'.

customer_rating.description: Minimum average customer rating required for brands of the product within <class>.

availability_status.description: Indicates whether only currently available brands should be considered within <class>.
